blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus.
blocks.zh: 多式联运测试时间适应(TTA)使得预先训练的多式联运模型能够在推论中仅使用无标签的测试数据来适应分布变化,而无需使用原始的培训数据. 与单一模式适应相比,多种代表性观点的共存和互动使多式联运适应更加复杂。 这种复杂性在模式可靠性变化中尤为突出,这种变化保留了模式的可用性,但降低了信息质量,模式可用性变化使得相应的模式完全无法使用。 类-有条件的高斯模型为处理这种分布性变化提供了自然的起点,在单一模式测试时间调整中证明对表示性分布的定性是有效的,但将这种模型扩展至多模式环境需要更细致的表述。 为此,我们提出适应性概率高斯校正(AdaPGC),将类别有条件的高斯模型扩展至特定模式和多模式聚变表示,以便在多模式分配转移下进行概率校正。 AdaPGC不断更新条件类高斯模型超过模式特异性和聚变表示,利用由此产生的概率预测来校正源模型预测并引导基于可靠性的校正,同时利用其联合分布来恢复无法得到的聚变表示. 在多种模式下进行的广泛实验表明,AdaPGC在模式可靠性和可用性转变下有效地提高了稳健性。 我们的源代码将在https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus上发布.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Fig. 1: Illustration of modality reliability and availability shifts in multimodal TTA.
Under reliability shifts, corrupted modalities distort the corresponding modality-specific representations and consequently affect the multimodal fusion representation.
Under availability shifts, missing modalities make the corresponding modality-specific representations unavailable and prevent the fusion representation from being directly constructed, motivating its recovery from the remaining modality.
blocks.zh:
发相. 1: 多式联运贸易协定模式可靠性和可用性变化的说明。
在可靠性变化的情况下,腐败的模式扭曲了相应的特定模式的表述,从而影响到多模式组合的表述。
在可用性变化的情况下,缺失模式使得相应的特定模式表述无法使用,并阻止了聚变表述的直接构建,促使其从剩余模式中恢复。

blocks.en:
Multimodal models integrate complementary information from heterogeneous data sources [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] and have demonstrated considerable promise in tasks such as action recognition [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] , sentiment analysis [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 ] , and other complex perception tasks [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] .
Conventional multimodal models are often vulnerable to distribution shifts, wherein discrepancies between the source and target domains can precipitate pronounced performance degradation [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] .
In response to this limitation, multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] has emerged as a viable paradigm, which dynamically adapts multimodal models using only unlabeled target data, thus facilitating real-time robustness enhancement under distribution shifts.
blocks.zh:
多式联运模式综合了来自不同数据来源[1、2、3]的补充信息,在诸如行动识别[4、5、6、7、8]、情绪分析[9、10、11、12、13]和其他复杂认知任务[14、15、16、17、18、19、20]等任务中表现出了相当大的希望。
常规多模式模式往往容易受到分销变化的影响,其中源域和目标域之间的差异可能使绩效明显退化[21、22、23]。
针对这一限制,多式联运测试时间适应[TTA][24,25,26]已经成为一种可行的范式,它仅使用未加标签的目标数据而动态地调整了多式联运模型,从而促进了在分销转移中实时增强稳健性.

blocks.en:
Recent unimodal TTA methods [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] model category-conditional distributions of test-time representations through Gaussian discriminant analysis (GDA) [ 30 , 31 ] and have demonstrated consistent improvements under distribution shifts.
However, extending such distribution modeling to multimodal TTA is considerably more challenging.
Compared with unimodal models, multimodal models derive multiple modality-specific representations together with a multimodal fusion representation [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] , making it insufficient to treat the distribution modeled in each interrelated but distinct perspective merely as an independent basis for prediction.
Crucially, the coexistence of multiple representation perspectives renders test-time distribution shifts substantially more intricate in multimodal settings [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
最近采用单式TTA方法[27,28,29],通过高斯族歧视分析(GDA)[30,31]对试验时间表示的型号类条件分布,并在分布变化中表现出了一致的改进.
然而,将这种分销模式推广到多式联运贸易协定则具有更大的挑战性。
与单式模型相比,多式模型得出了多种特定模式的表示,同时得出了多式聚变表示[32、33、34],因此不足以将每一种相互关联但截然不同的分布模式仅仅作为独立的预测基础。
关键的是,多种代表性观点的并存使测试时间分配在多式联运环境中的转变更为复杂[35]。

blocks.en:
Specifically, as illustrated in Figure 1 , test-time distribution shifts in multimodal settings are further complicated by modality reliability shifts and modality availability shifts .
Under modality reliability shifts , the affected modality remains fully observable, while its information quality deteriorates due to noise, blur, environmental interference, or other corruptions.
Such degradation can distort the corresponding modality-specific representation, subsequently perturbing the multimodal fusion representation and ultimately compromising prediction performance [ 36 ] . Modality availability shifts constitute a more disruptive form of test-time variation, occurring when sensor failures, transmission interruptions, or privacy restrictions render the corresponding modality entirely unavailable for certain test instances [ 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 ] .
In this case, not only is the representation of the missing modality inaccessible, but the corresponding multimodal fusion representation can no longer be directly constructed, resulting in a more severe loss of complementary information.
Addressing these two forms of distribution shift therefore requires a more nuanced exploitation of the information available across different representation perspectives.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,如图1所示,多式联运环境中的试验时间分配变化由于模式可靠性变化和模式可用性变化而变得更加复杂。
在方式可靠性变化的情况下,受影响的方式仍然完全可以观察到,而其信息质量则由于噪音、模糊、环境干扰或其他腐败而恶化。
这种退化可能扭曲相应的特定模式代表,从而扰乱多模式聚变代表,并最终损害预测性能[36]。 模式可用性变化是一种更具有破坏性的试验时间变化形式,在传感器故障、传输中断或隐私限制使某些试验情况完全无法采用相应方式时发生[37、38、39、40]。
在这种情况下,不仅无法代表缺失模式,而且无法直接构建相应的多模式聚变代表,导致补充信息损失更严重.
因此,要解决这两种分配方式的转变,就需要从不同的代表角度更细致地利用现有的信息。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we exploit the distributional information revealed by different representation perspectives in the target stream to calibrate source-model predictions under varying modality distribution shifts.
More concretely, modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations characterize category structure from different information sources, and their corresponding distributional predictions therefore vary with changes in modality reliability [ 41 ] .
When the reliability of a modality degrades, the resulting probabilistic predictions from different perspectives become relatively inconsistent.
Such discrepancies can serve as an indicator of which modality is more strongly affected and thereby support targeted prediction calibration.
Meanwhile, complete-modality test instances naturally provide simultaneously observed modality-specific and fusion representations, forming online paired observations in the target stream.
These pairs provide a statistical basis for recovering the unavailable fusion representation from the observed modality.
Such recovery can partially compensate for the multimodal predictive information lost when direct fusion becomes impossible due to modality missingness [ 42 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
为了应对这些挑战,我们利用目标流中不同代表性视角所揭示的分布信息,在不同的模式分布变化下校正源模型预测.
更具体地说,特定模式和多模式的聚变表示是不同信息来源的类别结构的特点,因此,它们相应的分布预测随着模式可靠性的变化而有所不同[41].
当一种方式的可靠性退化后,由此产生的从不同角度的概率预测会变得相对不一致.
这种差异可以作为影响更强烈的模式的一个指标,从而支持有针对性的预测校正。
同时,完整模式测试实例自然同时提供被观测到的特有模式和聚变表述,在目标流中形成在线对接观测.
这些对子为从观测到的模式中恢复无法使用的聚变表示提供了统计基础。
这种恢复可以部分补偿由于模式缺失而无法直接聚变而损失的多式联运预测信息[42,43].

blocks.en:
Building on these considerations, we propose Ada ptive P robabilistic G aussian C alibration (AdaPGC), 1 1 1 This work extends our preliminary conference paper [ 44 ] in the following aspects:
(1) we broaden the problem scope from modality reliability shifts under fully observed inputs to multimodal TTA under both reliability and availability variations;
(2) we augment the original probabilistic calibration framework with category-conditional joint distribution modeling, enabling cross-perspective statistical dependencies to support fusion representation inference under modality missingness; and
(3) we considerably expand the empirical evaluation to encompass a wider spectrum of modality corruption and missingness scenarios. a probabilistic approach for multimodal TTA under varying modality reliability and availability.
AdaPGC builds category-conditional Gaussian models for different representation perspectives and continuously updates them using statistics from the target stream.
These models yield probabilistic predictions that provide distribution-aware calibration signals for the source model under different forms of modality shift.
Under modality reliability shifts, probabilistic predictions from different perspectives are compared to assess relative modality reliability, based on which we employ a contrastive rectification approach to correct the representation of the less reliable modality.
Under modality availability shifts, AdaPGC further extends the category-conditional Gaussian modeling to the joint distribution of modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations, with the model parameters learned from modality-complete test instances.
This extension yields a closed-form conditional estimate of the unavailable fusion representation from the observed modality. This estimate is then incorporated into the probabilistic calibration of source model predictions.
Overall, our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We study multimodal TTA under both modality reliability and availability shifts, covering scenarios where modalities remain observable but vary in reliability, as well as scenarios where part of the multimodal input becomes unavailable.
This setting allows us to systematically investigate robustness to both corrupted and incomplete multimodal observations. • We propose AdaPGC, a probabilistic approach for multimodal TTA under both modality reliability and availability shifts.
AdaPGC models both category-conditional distributions and the dependencies between modality-specific and fusion representations, enabling a unified probabilistic treatment of fully observed, corrupted, and partially observed multimodal inputs. • We conduct extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions, demonstrating the effectiveness and robustness of AdaPGC under both modality reliability and availability shifts.
blocks.zh:
基于这些考虑,我们提议Ada Ptive P robabilistic Gausian C alibration(AdaPGC), 11 1 这项工作在以下几个方面延长了我们的初步会议文件:
(1) 我们扩大了问题范围,从在充分观察的投入下模式可靠性的转变,到在可靠性和可得性两方面的多式贸易协定;
(2) 我们用类别条件联合分布模型来扩充原有概率校正框架,使跨视角的统计依赖性能够支持模式缺失下的聚变表示推论;
(3) 我们大大扩展了实证评价,以涵盖更广泛的模式腐败和缺失情况。 根据不同方式的可靠性和可用性,对多式联运贸易协定采取概率办法。
AdaPGC为不同的代表视角构建了有条件的类别高斯模型,并使用目标流的统计数据不断更新.
这些模型产生概率预测,为不同模式转移形式下的源模型提供分布-认知校正信号.
在模式可靠性变化中,从不同角度对概率预测与相对模式可靠性的评估进行比较,在此基础上,我们采用对比式纠正方法来纠正不太可靠的模式的表示.
在模式可用性变化下,AdaPGC进一步将条件类高斯模型扩展至模式特有和多模式聚变表示的联合分布,模型参数从模式-完整测试实例中学习.
这种扩展产生一个封闭式的有条件估计,即无法从观测到的方式得到聚变代表。 然后将这一估计纳入源模型预测的概率校正.
总体而言,我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们研究了模式可靠性和可得性变化的多式贸易安排,包括模式仍然可观察但可靠性各有不同的情况,以及无法提供部分多式联运投入的情况。
这种环境使我们能够系统地调查对腐败和不完整的多式观测的力度。 我们提议采用AdaPGC,这是在模式可靠性和可得性变化下,多式联运贸易安排的一种概率办法。
AdaPGC模型既包括类别条件分布,也包括特定模式和聚变表示之间的依赖性,从而能够对完全被观察到、被腐蚀和部分被观察到的多模式输入进行统一概率处理。 我们根据不同模式的腐败和缺失条件进行了广泛的试验,显示了AdaPGC在模式可靠性和可用性变化下的有效性和稳健性。

blocks.en:
We study multimodal TTA under both modality reliability and availability shifts, covering scenarios where modalities remain observable but vary in reliability, as well as scenarios where part of the multimodal input becomes unavailable.
This setting allows us to systematically investigate robustness to both corrupted and incomplete multimodal observations.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了模式可靠性和可得性变化的多式贸易安排,包括模式仍然可观察但可靠性各有不同的情况,以及无法提供部分多式联运投入的情况。
这种环境使我们能够系统地调查对腐败和不完整的多式观察是否有力。

blocks.en:
We propose AdaPGC, a probabilistic approach for multimodal TTA under both modality reliability and availability shifts.
AdaPGC models both category-conditional distributions and the dependencies between modality-specific and fusion representations, enabling a unified probabilistic treatment of fully observed, corrupted, and partially observed multimodal inputs.
blocks.zh:
我们提议采用AdaPGC,这是在模式可靠性和可得性变化下,多式联运贸易安排的一种概率办法。
AdaPGC模式既包括类别条件分布,也包括模式特定和聚变表示之间的依赖性,从而能够对完全被观察到、被腐蚀和部分被观察到的多模式输入进行统一概率处理。

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions, demonstrating the effectiveness and robustness of AdaPGC under both modality reliability and availability shifts.
blocks.zh: 我们根据不同模式的腐败和缺失条件进行了广泛的试验,显示了AdaPGC在模式可靠性和可用性变化下的有效性和稳健性。

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en: II-A Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation
blocks.zh: II-A 多式联运 试验时间适应

blocks.en:
Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts a pretrained model to distribution shifts using only unlabeled target data.
Representative unimodal approaches include entropy minimization with TENT [ 45 ] , informative sample selection with EATA [ 46 ] and SAR [ 47 ] , and test-time classifier adjustment with T3A [ 48 ] .
These studies establish the basic adaptation mechanisms in unimodal settings, while multimodal TTA further considers the complementary information and interactions among different modalities.
blocks.zh:
测试时间适应 (TTA) 调整一个预先训练的模型,只使用无标签的目标数据来进行分配转移.
具有代表性的单式方法包括:将Entropy最小化,TENT[45];将EATA[46]和SAR[47]的样本选择信息化;将试验时间与T3A[48]进行分级调整。
这些研究建立了单式环境中的基本适应机制,而多式贸易安排则进一步审议了不同模式之间的互补信息和相互作用。

blocks.en:
Building on this setting, existing multimodal TTA methods exploit cross-modal information through diverse adaptation strategies.
MM-TTA [ 24 ] generates complementary pseudo-labels across modalities to facilitate source-free adaptation, although its effectiveness depends on the quality of the generated pseudo-labels.
READ [ 25 ] introduces a more robust approach by enhancing the impact of confident predictions and reducing the influence of noisy predictions.
Meanwhile, ABPEM [ 49 ] improves multimodal TTA by mitigating modality misalignment under distribution shift through attention bootstrapping and principal entropy minimization.
More recently, SuMi [ 26 ] employs smoothing and cross-modal information sharing to improve robustness under mixed shifts, including modality corruption and missingness.
TSA [ 50 ] , a recent method, further explores the problem of unimodal distribution shift through a selective adaptation framework that handles shifts in the affected modality.
BriMPR [ 35 ] addresses the coupled effects of unimodal feature shifts and cross-modal semantic misalignment through progressive re-alignment.
blocks.zh:
在这一背景下,现有的多式联运贸易安排方法通过各种适应战略利用了跨模式信息。
MM-TTA [24] 产生跨模式的补充伪标签来方便无源适应,虽然其有效性取决于生成的伪标签的质量.
READ [25] 引入了更稳健的方法,通过增强自信预测的影响并减少噪音预测的影响.
同时,ABPEM[49]改进了多模式的TTA,通过注意力夹和将主要 en最小化来减轻分配过程中的错配方式。
最近,Sumi [26] 利用平滑和跨模式的信息共享,在混合变化,包括模式腐败和缺失的情况下提高稳健性。
TSA [50],一种最新方法,通过处理受影响模式变化的有选择的适应框架,进一步探索了单式分销转移问题。
BrimPR[35]述及单模式特征转变和通过逐步重新调整而使跨模式语义错位的附带影响。

blocks.en:
Most existing methods are predicated on full modality observability and thus do not accommodate modality missing scenarios.
In contrast, AdaPGC jointly models marginal and cross-representation distributions, enabling unified adaptation to modality reliability and availability shifts.
blocks.zh:
大多数现有方法都以完全模式可观察性为前提,因此无法容纳模式缺失的情景。
相形之下,AdaPGC联合模拟了边际和跨代表分布,从而能够统一适应模式的可靠性和可用性的变化.

blocks.en: II-B Incomplete Multimodal Learning
blocks.zh: 二-B 不完全的多式联运学习

blocks.en:
Incomplete multimodal learning seeks to preserve predictive robustness under partially observed inputs, where variations in modality availability can otherwise result in substantial performance degradation.
Existing studies have developed various mechanisms for learning with incomplete multimodal inputs.
MAP [ 51 ] introduces modality-missing-aware prompts to equip pretrained multimodal transformers for diverse missing-modality conditions.
DCP [ 52 ] further models the correlations between prompts and input features, as well as those across different prompt layers, to better exploit cross-modal complementary information.
More recently, MoRA [ 53 ] introduces modality-common and modality-specific low-rank parameters to facilitate bidirectional cross-modal knowledge transfer while preserving modality-specific flexibility.
blocks.zh:
不完整的多模式学习力求在部分观察到的投入下保持预测的稳健性,否则模式可用性的变化会导致绩效严重退化。
现有的研究为学习不完全的多模式投入建立了各种机制。
MAP[51]引入了模式缺失-意识提示来为各种模式缺失条件装备经过预先培训的多式变压器.
DCP [52] 进一步模拟了提示和输入特征之间以及不同提示层之间的关联,以便更好地利用跨模式互补信息。
最近,MORA[53]引入了模式共同和模式特定低等参数,以促进双向跨模式知识转让,同时保留模式特定的灵活性。

blocks.en:
A limited number of studies have investigated missing modalities under the more restrictive TTA setting.
MiDl [ 39 ] combines mutual information minimization with self-distillation to adapt multimodal models using incomplete test inputs.
SuMi [ 26 ] handles missing modalities by smoothing distribution shifts between complete and incomplete observations.
blocks.zh:
为数有限的一些研究调查了在限制性更强的贸易协定设定下缺失的模式。
MiDl [39] 将互通信息最小化与自去蒸发相结合,用不完整的测试输入来适应多模式.
Sumi [26] 通过平滑完整和不完整的观测之间的分布移来处理缺失模式.

blocks.en:
Despite this progress, existing methods primarily enhance predictions from the available modalities, without explicitly recovering the inaccessible fusion representation.
AdaPGC addresses this limitation by modeling the category-conditional distributions of modality-specific and fusion representations, enabling the missing fusion representation to be inferred from the observed modality.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有方法主要加强了对现有模式的预测,而没有明确恢复无法进入的聚变代表。
AdaPGC通过模拟特定方式和聚变表示的类别条件分布,使缺失的聚变表示能从所观察到的方式中推断出来,从而解决了这一局限性.

blocks.en: II-C Distribution Modeling for TTA
blocks.zh: II-C TTA 分销模型

blocks.en:
Distribution modeling provides a probabilistic basis for test-time adaptation by estimating the category structure of unlabeled target representations.
In particular, category-conditional Gaussian modeling enables posterior inference through Gaussian discriminant analysis (GDA), using feature statistics accumulated during inference.
DOTA [ 28 ] continuously estimates category-conditional distributions and derives posterior probabilities via Bayesian inference, mitigating the forgetting associated with limited sample caches.
FreeTTA [ 29 ] employs online expectation-maximization to estimate target distributions, incorporating zero-shot predictions as prior information.
BayesTTA [ 27 ] further considers temporally evolving distributions, combining incremental Gaussian estimation with adaptive covariance selection to calibrate predictions and guide representation adaptation.
ADAPT [ 54 ] incorporates CLIP priors and a historical knowledge bank to correct potential likelihood biases, refining GDA-based inference without backpropagation.
These studies demonstrate the value of target feature statistics for informing test-time predictions.
blocks.zh:
分配模型通过估计无标签目标表示的类别结构,为测试时间的调整提供了概率基础.
特别是,类别有条件的高斯模型化能够通过高斯歧视分析(GDA)进行后推论,利用在推论中积累的特征统计.
DOTA [28] 不断估计类别条件分布,并通过贝叶斯推论获得后概率,减轻与有限的样本缓存相关的遗忘.
FreeTTA [29] 采用在线预期-最大分数来估计目标分布,将零镜头预测作为事前信息.
BayesTTA [27] 进一步审议了时间上不断发展的分布,将增量高斯估计与适应性共变选择相结合,以校正预测并指导表现适应.
ADAPT [54] 纳入了CLIP的前科和一个历史知识库,以纠正潜在的概率偏差,在不反向传播的情况下完善基于GDA的推论.
这些研究表明,目标特征统计对为测试时间预测提供信息具有价值。

blocks.en:
These approaches primarily model distributions in a single visual representation space.
AdaPGC extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling to modality-specific and fusion representations, using their marginal distributions for probabilistic calibration and their joint distributions for fusion representation recovery.

blocks.en: IV Method
blocks.zh: 四. 方法

blocks.en:
This section presents the proposed AdaPGC framework.
We first formulate multimodal test-time adaptation under modality distribution shifts, covering modality degradation and modality missingness.
We then introduce online category-conditional Gaussian modeling for modality-specific and fusion representations, which provides the probabilistic foundation for subsequent adaptation.
Based on these Gaussian distributions, we develop Gaussian probabilistic calibration to refine source-model predictions, where the joint distributions between modality-specific and fusion representations are further exploited to recover unavailable fusion representations under modality missingness.
Finally, for samples affected by single-modality degradation, we introduce adaptive contrastive rectification to identify the relatively degraded modality and selectively rectify its representation while preserving the reliable modality.
The overall framework is illustrated in Figure 2 .

然后,我们引入了针对特定模式和聚变表达的在线类条件高斯模型,为随后的适应提供了概率基础.
基于这些高斯分布,我们开发出高斯概率校正来完善出源模型预测,在模式特异性和聚变表达之间的联合分布被进一步利用来恢复模式缺失下无法得到的聚变表达.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Gaussian Parameter Initialization

blocks.en:
A fundamental challenge in online Gaussian modeling is how to obtain informative priors for the category-conditional parameters before sufficient target samples have been observed.
Since source data are unavailable during test-time adaptation, we instead exploit the category knowledge already encoded in the pretrained classifier to initialize these parameters.
blocks.zh:
在线高斯建模中的一个基本挑战是如何在观测到足够的目标样本之前获得关于类别条件参数的信息前科。
由于在测试-时间适应期间没有源数据,我们反而利用在预先训练的分类器中已经编码的类别知识来初始化这些参数.

blocks.en:

Meanwhile, pretrained classifier weights have been shown to encode category prototype information [ 48 ] .
This correspondence allows the pretrained classifier to provide an informative initialization for the category-conditional Gaussian parameters.
We further adopt an isotropic covariance initialization, avoiding the introduction of additional category-specific structure before target statistics become available.

Since both unimodal and multimodal representations are required for reliability assessment and cross-modal alignment, this rectification is performed only on complete-modality test instances in 𝒟 full t \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{full}}^{t} .

blocks.en:
To evaluate robustness against different types of multimodal distribution shifts, we consider both modality corruption and modality missingness scenarios.
Specifically, we construct corrupted datasets, Kinetics50-C and VGGSound-C, derived from Kinetics50 [ 58 ] and VGGSound [ 59 ] .
Kinetics50 contains YouTube videos of human actions across 50 categories, while VGGSound includes 309 audio-visual categories, covering a wide range of real-world audio-visual events.
Following previous work [ 60 , 25 ] , we introduce 15 visual distortions (e.g., Gaussian noise, motion blur, brightness variations) and six audio disturbances (e.g., traffic noise, rain noise) to simulate real-world distribution shifts.
These distortions resulted in the corrupted Kinetics50-C and VGGSound-C datasets, which were then used for our evaluation, providing a challenging benchmark for multimodal test-time adaptation.
We further construct modality-missing test streams from the original Kinetics50 and VGGSound datasets to evaluate model robustness when one or more modalities become unavailable during inference.
Following previous work [ 51 , 52 ] , we consider three settings:
Audio Missing, where η % \eta\% of the samples contain only the visual modality;
Visual Missing, where η % \eta\% of the samples contain only the audio modality; and
Both Missing, where η 2 % \frac{\eta}{2}\% of the samples are audio-only and another η 2 % \frac{\eta}{2}\% are visual-only.
The remaining ( 100 − η ) % (100-\eta)\% of the samples retain both modalities. We evaluate 5 missing rates, with η ∈ { 50 % , 60 % , 70 % , 80 % , 90 % } \eta\in\{50\%,60\%,70\%,80\%,90\%\} .

为了对照不同类型的多模式分销变化评估稳健性,我们考虑了模式腐败和模式缺失两种情况。
具体来说,我们构建了由Kinetics50 [58] 和VGGSound[59]衍生出来的被腐蚀的数据集Kinetics50-C和VGGSound-C.

We compare the proposed method AdaPGC with a comprehensive set of representative test-time adaptation approaches.
Specifically, we include both unimodal and multimodal TTA methods to evaluate their effectiveness under challenging multimodal distribution shifts.
For unimodal TTA, we consider entropy minimization-based methods, including TENT [ 45 ] , EATA [ 46 ] , and SAR [ 47 ] .
For multimodal TTA, we compare with MM-TTA [ 24 ] , READ [ 25 ] , ABPEM [ 49 ] , SuMi [ 26 ] , BriMPR [ 35 ] , and TSA [ 50 ] , which are designed to exploit multimodal interactions and improve adaptation under modality variations.
These baselines provide a comprehensive comparison with our probabilistic calibration framework.

我们把拟议的AdaPGC方法与一整套具有代表性的试验时间适应方法进行比较。
具体地说,我们既包括单式贸易协定方法,也包括多式贸易协定方法,以评估它们在挑战多式销售转变的情况下的有效性。
对于单式TTA,我们考虑采用最小化方法,包括TENT [45]、EATA [46]和SAR [47]。
关于多式联运,我们与MM-TTA[24]、READ[25]、ABPEM[49]、Sumi[26]、BrimPR[35]和TSA[50]进行对比,它们旨在利用多式联运的相互作用,并改进模式变化下的适应。
这些基线提供了与我们概率校准框架的全面比较。

blocks.en:
We first evaluate the overall performance of AdaPGC under different multimodal distribution shift scenarios.
As shown in Tables I - III , AdaPGC achieves the best average performance under modality corruption scenarios, where video and audio modalities are independently evaluated under different corruption types.
Tables IV - V further report the results under modality missingness scenarios, where AdaPGC achieves consistent improvements across different missing patterns.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评价AdaPGC在不同的多模式分配转变设想下的总体业绩。
如表一至三所示,AdaPGC在模式腐败情景下取得了最佳平均业绩,在模式腐败情景下,视频和音频模式根据不同的腐败类型进行独立评价。
表四至表五还报告了模式缺失设想方案下的结果,其中AdaPGC在不同的缺失模式中取得了一致的改进。

blocks.en:
Under modality corruption scenarios, AdaPGC demonstrates consistent robustness against diverse types of visual and audio degradations.
Across the corruption benchmarks, AdaPGC achieves competitive average accuracy in both video-corrupted and audio-corrupted settings on both datasets.
The improvements are consistently observed across different corruption types rather than being limited to specific corruption.
For example, on Kinetics50-C with corrupted video inputs, AdaPGC improves the average accuracy from 65.9% achieved by the strongest competing method to 66.7%.
For corrupted audio inputs on VGGSound-C, AdaPGC further improves the average accuracy from 36.5% to 37.5%, with consistent gains across various audio disturbances.
These results indicate that modeling category-conditional representation distributions provides reliable calibration signals when modality information is affected by different types of corruption.
blocks.zh:
在模式腐败设想下,AdaPGC表现出了针对各种视觉和音频退化的一贯强力。
在整个腐败基准中,AdaPGC在两个数据集的录像和录音设置上都实现了竞争性平均准确性。
在不同的腐败类型中始终看到这些改进,而不是局限于具体的腐败。
例如,在有被腐蚀的视频输入的Kinetics50-C上,AdaPGC将平均精度从最强相竞方法实现的65.9%提高到66.7%.
对于VGGSound-C上损坏的音频输入,AdaPGC进一步提高了从36.5%到37.5%的平均准确度,在各种音频扰动中取得了一致的收益.
这些结果表明,在模式信息受到不同类型腐败影响时,模拟类别有条件的表示分布提供了可靠的校准信号。

blocks.en:
Under modality missingness scenarios, AdaPGC improves the adaptation performance when partial modality information becomes unavailable.
Across different missing configurations and missing ratios, AdaPGC achieves the highest average accuracy on both Kinetics50 and VGGSound benchmarks.
The performance remains stable as the missing ratio increases, demonstrating the effectiveness of recovering latent fusion representations from the available modality information.
For example, on Kinetics50 with the video modality missing in 90% of samples, AdaPGC achieves 52.2% accuracy, exceeding the best competing result by 1.3 percentage points.
Similarly, under the Both Missing setting with a 90% missing ratio, AdaPGC improves accuracy from the best baseline result of 59.5% to 61.1%.
These results verify that the proposed cross-perspective representation recovery effectively preserves discriminative multimodal information even when complete multimodal inputs are unavailable.
blocks.zh:
在模式缺失设想方案下,AdaPGC在部分模式信息无法获取时改进了适应性能.
纵观不同的缺失配置和缺失比率,AdaPGC在Kinetics50和VGGSound基准上都实现了最高平均准确度.
随着缺失比率的增加,性能保持稳定,表明从现有模式信息中恢复潜在聚变表达的有效性。
例如,在Kinetics50上,90%的样本中缺少视频模式,AdaPGC的精度达到52.2%,超过了最佳竞争结果1.3个百分点.
同样地,在两个缺失的设定中,缺失比率为90%,AdaPGC的准确性从59.5%的最佳基线结果提高到61.1%。
这些结果证实,即使没有完整的多式联运投入,拟议的跨视角代表回收也有效地保存了歧视性的多式联运信息。

blocks.en:
We further conduct ablation studies to investigate the contribution of each component in AdaPGC.
The results are summarized in Table VI .
Specifically, we evaluate three components: the fused-logit calibration mechanism (FL; ( 30 )), which integrates the calibration logits with the original model predictions to refine the final output; the prediction alignment loss (PA; ( 29 )), which uses the calibration prediction as supervision to guide test-time optimization; and the asymmetric rectification module (AR; ( 33 )), which mitigates the impact of inconsistent modality reliability by rectifying the representation of the less reliable modality.
When all three components are included, AdaPGC achieves the highest average accuracy in each of the three evaluation settings; removing any component reduces the corresponding average accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步开展减征研究,调查AdaPGC每个组成部分的贡献。
调查结果摘要见表六。
具体而言,我们评价了三个组成部分:将校正对数与原始模型预测相结合的引信-记录校正机制(FL; (30)),以完善最终产出;预测对接损失(PA; (29)),以校正预测为监督,以指导测试时间优化;不对称校正模块(AR; (33)),通过纠正不可靠模式的表述来减轻不一致模式可靠性的影响.
当将所有三个组件都包含在内时,AdaPGC在三个评价设置中各实现最高平均精度;去除任何组件都会降低相应的平均精度.

blocks.en: FL consistently improves the baseline across all three settings, increasing the average accuracy by 2.45, 1.48, and 0.73 percentage points on Video-C, Audio-C, and Missing, respectively. Its contribution remains evident when PA is already enabled, where adding FL further improves the average accuracy from 64.40 to 65.71 on Video-C, from 72.17 to 73.05 on Audio-C, and from 65.49 to 66.09 under modality missingness. These results demonstrate that directly incorporating Gaussian calibration into the final prediction provides complementary information beyond adapting the model parameters alone.
blocks.zh: FL持续改善所有三种设置的基线,将Video-C、Audio-C和Missing的平均精度分别提高2.45分、1.48分和0.73分。 在巴勒斯坦权力机构已经启用时,其贡献仍然很明显,增加FL进一步提高了视频-C的平均准确度,从64.40到65.71;音频-C从72.17到73.05;模式缺失从65.49到66.09。 这些结果表明,将高斯校正直接纳入最终预测中,除了单独调整模型参数之外,还提供了补充信息。

blocks.en:
PA yields the largest standalone improvement under modality corruption, raising the average accuracy by 3.76 percentage points on Video-C and 2.95 percentage points on Audio-C. This indicates that the probabilistic predictions derived from online Gaussian distributions provide effective supervision for adapting the source model to reliability changes at test time.
Moreover, the consistent gains obtained by combining PA with FL show that Gaussian calibration serves two complementary roles: it can guide test-time model adaptation through PA while also directly calibrating the final prediction through FL.
blocks.zh:
巴勒斯坦权力机构在模式腐败下获得最大的独立改进,视频C的平均准确度提高了3.76个百分点,音频C提高了2.95个百分点。 这表明从在线高斯分布中得出的概率预测为在测试时使源模型适应可靠性变化提供了有效的监督.
此外,通过将PA与FL合并而获得的一致收益表明高斯校正有两个互补的作用:它可以通过PA指导测试时间模型的适应,同时通过FL直接校正最终预测.

blocks.en: AR provides a distinct contribution that is primarily concentrated on modality corruption. When used alone, it improves the average accuracy by 2.78 and 1.55 percentage points on Video-C and Audio-C, respectively, while producing only a marginal improvement under modality missingness. A similar pattern is observed when AR is added to FL and PA: the average accuracy increases from 65.71 to 66.73 on Video-C and from 73.05 to 73.35 on Audio-C, whereas the change under modality missingness is negligible. This behavior is consistent with the role of AR, which is specifically designed to rectify degraded modality representations rather than compensate for unavailable modalities. Its benefit is particularly evident under several corruption conditions, such as Snow, where AR alone improves the accuracy from 61.09 to 65.32.
blocks.zh: 反腐败报告提供了一种独特的贡献,主要集中于模式腐败。 单用后,将Video-C和Audio-C的平均精度分别提高2.78分和1.55分,同时在模式缺失下仅产生微小改善. 在将AR添加到FL和PA中时也观察到类似的模式:视频-C上的平均精度从65.71提高到66.73;音频-C上的平均精度从73.05提高到73.35;而模式缺失的变化是微不足道的。 这种行为与AR的作用是一致的,AR是专门用来纠正已退化的方式表达,而不是补偿无法使用的模式. 在一些腐败条件下,例如Snow,其好处特别明显,仅AR就提高了准确度,从61.09提高到65.32。

blocks.en: Overall, FL, PA, and AR operate at complementary levels: FL directly calibrates the prediction, PA transfers probabilistic calibration into test-time model adaptation, and AR rectifies degraded modality representations. Combining all three components achieves the highest average accuracy on Video-C, Audio-C, and Missing, confirming their complementary contributions to robust adaptation under modality shifts.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,《前线法》、《巴勒斯坦权力机构法》和《年度报告》是相辅相成的: FL直接校正了预测,PA将概率校正转移到了测试时间模型的适应中,AR校正了已退化的模式表示. 将所有三个组成部分合并起来,就能在Video-C、Audio-C和Missing上达到最高平均准确度,从而证实它们在模式转变下对有力的适应作出了互补贡献。

blocks.en:
We investigate the sensitivity of AdaPGC to the residual calibration weight λ \lambda , which scales the Gaussian calibration term added to the source-model logits.

To examine how adaptation performance evolves as test samples arrive, we compare the cumulative accuracy of AdaPGC with the source model and representative multimodal TTA methods.
Figure 7 presents results under selected audio corruptions, video corruptions, and missing-modality conditions.
Despite initial fluctuations, AdaPGC achieves the highest final cumulative accuracy across all displayed conditions.
Under modality corruption, AdaPGC maintains a clear advantage in most cases, particularly for thunder noise, shot noise, and JPEG compression.
Some competing methods exhibit declining accuracy as adaptation proceeds, such as SuMi under rain noise, whereas AdaPGC maintains relatively stable performance.
Moreover, under glass blur, elastic transformation, and JPEG compression, AdaPGC exhibits an overall upward trend in cumulative accuracy after the initial fluctuations, indicating that its predictions improve as adaptation proceeds.
Under modality missingness, AdaPGC also achieves consistent improvements at both 80% and 90% missing rates.
These results complement the aggregate comparisons and demonstrate the effectiveness of AdaPGC throughout adaptation under corrupted and incomplete multimodal inputs.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
This work presents AdaPGC, a probabilistic multimodal test-time adaptation framework for distribution shifts involving variations in both modality reliability and availability.
AdaPGC continuously models category-conditional distributions over modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model outputs throughout the target stream.
Beyond prediction calibration, AdaPGC exploits cross-perspective distributional information to rectify degraded modality representations and further models the joint distributions between modality-specific and fusion representations to recover unavailable fusion information under modality missingness.
Extensive experiments across diverse corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC consistently improves adaptation robustness over existing approaches, validating the effectiveness of probabilistic distribution modeling for multimodal test-time adaptation under complex modality shifts.
blocks.zh:
这项工作提出了AdaPGC, 即一种有概率的多式联运测试时间调整框架,用于分配转移,包括模式可靠性和可用性的变化。
AdaPGC在模式特定和多模式聚变表示上持续地模拟类-条件分布,利用由此产生的概率预测来校正整个目标流的源模型输出.
除了预测校正外,AdaPGC还利用跨视角分布信息来纠正已退化模式表达,并进一步模拟模式特定和聚变表达之间的联合分布,以恢复模式缺失情况下无法获得的聚变信息.
涉及各种腐败和缺失条件的广泛实验表明,AdaPGC比起现有方法,不断提高适应的稳健性,验证了在复杂的模式变化下为多式联运测试-时间适应而采用概率分配模式的有效性。

blocks.en: Appendix B Sensitivity Analysis of Adaptation Batch Size
blocks.zh: 附录B 对适应批量大小的敏感性分析

blocks.en:
We investigate the sensitivity of AdaPGC to the adaptation batch size.
As shown in Figure 10 , increasing the batch size does not consistently improve performance.
A batch size of 16 achieves the highest average accuracy under audio corruption and modality missing, while a batch size of 8 performs slightly better under video corruption, with a difference of 0.15 percentage points.
Further increasing the batch size to 32 or 64 yields lower average accuracy across all three settings than using 16.
These results support a batch size of 16 as a consistent choice across different distribution shifts, balancing performance under modality corruption and missingness. Therefore, we adopt a batch size of 16 in our experiments.
blocks.zh:

如图10所示,增加批量规模并不能持续改善业绩。
在音频腐败和模式缺失的情况下,16个分批体积达到最高平均准确度,而8个分批体积在视频腐败的情况下表现略好,相差0.15个百分点.
将批量尺寸进一步增加到32个或64个,在所有三种情况下的平均准确度都低于16个。
这些结果支持将16个批量规模作为不同分配变化的一致选择,平衡模式腐败和缺失下的业绩。 因此,我们在实验中采用了16个批量尺寸。
